verses.original: וְיוֹסֵ֖ף הוּרַ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יְמָה וַיִּקְנֵ֡הוּ פּוֹטִיפַר֩ סְרִ֨יס פַּרְעֹ֜ה שַׂ֤ר הַטַּבָּחִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י מִיַּד֙ הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹרִדֻ֖הוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·sêp̄ hū·raḏ miṣ·rā·yə·māh way·yiq·nê·hū pō·w·ṭî·p̄ar sə·rîs par·‘ōh śar haṭ·ṭab·bā·ḥîm ’îš miṣ·rî mî·yaḏ hay·yiš·mə·‘ê·lîm ’ă·šer hō·w·ri·ḏu·hū šām·māh
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Joseph had been taken down to Egypt where an Egyptian named Potiphar an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard . . . bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there
verses.literalPt: José foi conduzido ao Egito; e Potifar, oficial de Faraó, capitão da guarda, varão egípcio, comprou-o das mãos dos ismaelitas que o haviam conduzido para lá.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְהִ֖י אִ֣ישׁ מַצְלִ֑יחַ וַיְהִ֕י בְּבֵ֥ית אֲדֹנָ֖יו הַמִּצְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî Yah·weh ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ way·hî ’îš maṣ·lî·aḥ way·hî bə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāw ham·miṣ·rî
verses.literal: And the LORD was with Joseph and he became a successful man serving in the household of his Egyptian master
verses.literalPt: Jeová era com José, e ele veio a ser próspero; e estava na casa do egípcio, seu senhor.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא אֲדֹנָ֔יו כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אִתּ֑וֹ וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ה֣וּא עֹשֶׂ֔ה יְהוָ֖ה מַצְלִ֥יחַ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’ă·ḏō·nāw kî Yah·weh ’it·tōw wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- hū ‘ō·śeh Yah·weh maṣ·lî·aḥ bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: When his master saw that the LORD was with him and made him prosper . . . in all he did
verses.literalPt: Viu seu senhor que Jeová era com ele, e que tudo o que ele fazia Jeová o tornou próspero em suas mãos.

verses.original: וַיִּמְצָ֨א יוֹסֵ֥ף חֵ֛ן בְּעֵינָ֖יו וַיְשָׁ֣רֶת אֹת֑וֹ וַיַּפְקִדֵ֙הוּ֙ עַל־ בֵּית֔וֹ וְכָל־ יֶשׁ־ ל֖וֹ נָתַ֥ן בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·ṣā yō·w·sêp̄ ḥên bə·‘ê·nāw way·šā·reṯ ’ō·ṯōw way·yap̄·qi·ḏê·hū ‘al- bê·ṯōw wə·ḵāl yeš- lōw nā·ṯan bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: Joseph found favor in his sight and became his personal attendant Potiphar put him in charge of his household and entrusted . . . him with everything he owned
verses.literalPt: Achou José graça aos olhos dele e servia-o; seu senhor fê-lo mordomo da sua casa e tudo o que tinha pôs nas mãos de José.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֡י מֵאָז֩ הִפְקִ֨יד אֹת֜וֹ בְּבֵית֗וֹ וְעַל֙ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ־ ל֔וֹ וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית הַמִּצְרִ֖י בִּגְלַ֣ל יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְהִ֞י בִּרְכַּ֤ת יְהוָה֙ בְּכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ־ ל֔וֹ בַּבַּ֖יִת וּבַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mê·’āz hip̄·qîḏ ’ō·ṯōw bə·ḇê·ṯōw wə·‘al kāl- ’ă·šer yeš- lōw way·ḇā·reḵ Yah·weh ’eṯ- bêṯ ham·miṣ·rî biḡ·lal yō·w·sêp̄ way·hî bir·kaṯ Yah·weh bə·ḵāl ’ă·šer yeš- lōw bab·ba·yiṯ ū·ḇaś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: From the time that he put Joseph in charge of his household and all he owned the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s household on account of him . . . The LORD’s blessing was on everything he owned . . . both in his house and in his field
verses.literalPt: Desde que o fez mordomo na sua casa e pô-lo sobre tudo o que tinha, abençoou Jeová a casa do egípcio por amor de José; e a bênção de Jeová estava sobre tudo o que tinha, tanto na casa como no campo.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲזֹ֣ב כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֮ בְּיַד־ יוֹסֵף֒ וְלֹא־ יָדַ֤ע אִתּוֹ֙ מְא֔וּמָה כִּ֥י אִם־ הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁר־ ה֣וּא אוֹכֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף יְפֵה־ תֹ֖אַר וִיפֵ֥ה מַרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw bə·yaḏ- yō·w·sêp̄ wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ ’it·tōw mə·’ū·māh kî ’im- hal·le·ḥem ’ă·šer- hū ’ō·w·ḵêl way·hî yō·w·sêp̄ yə·p̄êh- ṯō·’ar wî·p̄êh mar·’eh
verses.literal: So Potiphar left all that he owned in Joseph’s care he did not concern himself . . . with anything except . . . the food he ate Now Joseph was well-built . . . and handsome . . .
verses.literalPt: Potifar deixou nas mãos de José tudo o que tinha; e não sabia nada do que estava com ele, a não ser o pão que comia. José era formoso de porte e de semblante.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַתִּשָּׂ֧א אֵֽשֶׁת־ אֲדֹנָ֛יו אֶת־ עֵינֶ֖יהָ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֑ף וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁכְבָ֥ה עִמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥar had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wat·tiś·śā ’ê·šeṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nāw ’eṯ- ‘ê·ne·hā ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ wat·tō·mer šiḵ·ḇāh ‘im·mî
verses.literal: and after some time . . . . . . his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph and said Sleep with me
verses.literalPt: Aconteceu, depois destas coisas, que a mulher do seu senhor pôs os olhos em José e lhe disse: Deita-te comigo.

verses.original: וַיְמָאֵ֓ן׀ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ אֵ֣שֶׁת אֲדֹנָ֔יו הֵ֣ן אֲדֹנִ֔י לֹא־ יָדַ֥ע אִתִּ֖י מַה־ בַּבָּ֑יִת וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֶשׁ־ ל֖וֹ נָתַ֥ן בְּיָדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·mā·’ên way·yō·mer ’el- ’ê·šeṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāw hên ’ă·ḏō·nî lō- yā·ḏa‘ ’it·tî mah- bab·bā·yiṯ wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yeš- lōw nā·ṯan bə·yā·ḏî
verses.literal: But he refused Look he said to his master’s wife with me here my master does not concern himself with anything in his house and he has entrusted everything he owns to my care
verses.literalPt: Mas ele recusou e disse à mulher do seu senhor: Meu senhor não sabe o que está comigo na sua casa e pôs tudo o que ele tem nas minhas mãos.

verses.original: אֵינֶ֨נּוּ גָד֜וֹל בַּבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּה֮ מִמֶּנִּי֒ וְלֹֽא־ חָשַׂ֤ךְ מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ מְא֔וּמָה כִּ֥י אִם־ אוֹתָ֖ךְ בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתְּ־ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֨יךְ אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֜ה הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וְחָטָ֖אתִי לֵֽאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·nen·nū ḡā·ḏō·wl bab·ba·yiṯ haz·zeh mim·men·nî wə·lō- ḥā·śaḵ mim·men·nî mə·’ū·māh kî ’im- ’ō·w·ṯāḵ ba·’ă·šer ’at- ’iš·tōw wə·’êḵ ’e·‘ĕ·śeh hā·rā·‘āh hag·gə·ḏō·lāh haz·zōṯ wə·ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: No one in this house is greater than I am He has withheld nothing . . . from me except you because you are his wife So how could I do such a great evil and sin against God
verses.literalPt: Ele não é maior do que eu nesta casa; e não reteve coisa alguma de mim, senão a ti, porque és sua mulher: como, pois, posso cometer esta grande maldade e pecar contra Deus?

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כְּדַבְּרָ֥הּ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֖ף י֣וֹם׀ י֑וֹם וְלֹא־ שָׁמַ֥ע אֵלֶ֛יהָ לִשְׁכַּ֥ב אֶצְלָ֖הּ לִהְי֥וֹת עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḏab·bə·rāh ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ yō·wm yō·wm wə·lō- šā·ma‘ ’ê·le·hā liš·kaḇ ’eṣ·lāh lih·yō·wṯ ‘im·māh
verses.literal: Although Potiphar’s wife spoke to Joseph day after day he refused . . . . . . to go to bed with her or even be near her
verses.literalPt: Falando ela a José todos os dias, ele não lhe dava ouvidos, para se deitar com ela e estar com ela.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כְּהַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֥א הַבַּ֖יְתָה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת מְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֨ין אִ֜ישׁ מֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת שָׁ֖ם בַּבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·hay·yō·wm haz·zeh way·yā·ḇō hab·bay·ṯāh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ mə·laḵ·tōw wə·’ên ’îš mê·’an·šê hab·ba·yiṯ šām bab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: One day . . . however Joseph went into the house to attend to his work and not a single household servant was inside
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, nestes dias, que entrou em casa para atender aos seus negócios; e não havia nenhum dos homens da casa lá dentro.

verses.original: וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂ֧הוּ בְּבִגְד֛וֹ לֵאמֹ֖ר שִׁכְבָ֣ה עִמִּ֑י וַיַּעֲזֹ֤ב בִּגְדוֹ֙ בְּיָדָ֔הּ וַיָּ֖נָס וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiṯ·pə·śê·hū bə·ḇiḡ·ḏōw lê·mōr šiḵ·ḇāh ‘im·mî way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ biḡ·ḏōw bə·yā·ḏāh way·yā·nās way·yê·ṣê ha·ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: She grabbed Joseph by his cloak and said Sleep with me But leaving his cloak in her hand he escaped and ran outside
verses.literalPt: Então ela lhe pegou pelo vestido, dizendo: Deita-te comigo; mas ele, deixando o seu vestido nas mãos dela, fugiu e saiu para fora.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ כִּרְאוֹתָ֔הּ כִּֽי־ עָזַ֥ב בִּגְד֖וֹ בְּיָדָ֑הּ וַיָּ֖נָס הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kir·’ō·w·ṯāh kî- ‘ā·zaḇ biḡ·ḏōw bə·yā·ḏāh way·yā·nās ha·ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house
verses.literalPt: Quando ela viu que ele havia deixado o seu vestido nas mãos dela e havia fugido para fora,

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָ֞א לְאַנְשֵׁ֣י בֵיתָ֗הּ וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר רְא֗וּ הֵ֥בִיא לָ֛נוּ אִ֥ישׁ עִבְרִ֖י לְצַ֣חֶק בָּ֑נוּ בָּ֤א אֵלַי֙ לִשְׁכַּ֣ב עִמִּ֔י וָאֶקְרָ֖א בְּק֥וֹל גָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rā lə·’an·šê ḇê·ṯāh wat·tō·mer lā·hem lê·mōr rə·’ū hê·ḇî lā·nū ’îš ‘iḇ·rî lə·ṣa·ḥeq bā·nū bā ’ê·lay liš·kaḇ ‘im·mî wā·’eq·rā bə·qō·wl gā·ḏō·wl
verses.literal: she called her household servants Look she said this Hebrew . . . has been brought to us to make sport of us He came to me so he could sleep with me but I screamed as loud as I could
verses.literalPt: chamou pelos homens da sua casa, e disse-lhes: Vede, introduziu meu marido a este hebreu para zombar de nós. Veio a mim para se deitar comigo, e gritei em alta voz;

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כְשָׁמְע֔וֹ כִּֽי־ הֲרִימֹ֥תִי קוֹלִ֖י וָאֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּעֲזֹ֤ב בִּגְדוֹ֙ אֶצְלִ֔י וַיָּ֖נָס וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵə·šā·mə·‘ōw kî- hă·rî·mō·ṯî qō·w·lî wā·’eq·rā way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ biḡ·ḏōw ’eṣ·lî way·yā·nās way·yê·ṣê ha·ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: When he heard me . . . scream for help . . . . . . he left his cloak beside me and ran . . . out of the house
verses.literalPt: ouvindo ele que eu levantava a voz e gritava, deixou o seu vestido comigo, fugiu e saiu para fora.

verses.original: וַתַּנַּ֥ח בִּגְד֖וֹ אֶצְלָ֑הּ עַד־ בּ֥וֹא אֲדֹנָ֖יו אֶל־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tan·naḥ biḡ·ḏōw ’eṣ·lāh ‘aḏ- bō·w ’ă·ḏō·nāw ’el- bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: So Potiphar’s wife kept Joseph’s cloak beside her until his master . . . came home
verses.literalPt: Ela guardou o vestido dele perto de si, até que o senhor dele voltou para casa.

verses.original: וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו כַּדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לֵאמֹ֑ר בָּֽא־ אֵלַ֞י הָעֶ֧בֶד הָֽעִבְרִ֛י אֲשֶׁר־ הֵבֵ֥אתָ לָּ֖נוּ לְצַ֥חֶק בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lāw kad·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh lê·mōr bā- ’ê·lay hā·‘e·ḇeḏ hā·‘iḇ·rî ’ă·šer- hê·ḇê·ṯā lā·nū lə·ṣa·ḥeq bî
verses.literal: Then she told him . . . the same . . . story The Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me
verses.literalPt: Então, ela lhe falou do seguinte modo: O servo hebreu, que nos trouxeste, veio ter comigo para zombar de mim;

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּהֲרִימִ֥י קוֹלִ֖י וָאֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּעֲזֹ֥ב בִּגְד֛וֹ אֶצְלִ֖י וַיָּ֥נָס הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·hă·rî·mî qō·w·lî wā·’eq·rā way·ya·‘ă·zōḇ biḡ·ḏōw ’eṣ·lî way·yā·nās ha·ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: but when I screamed for help . . . . . . he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house
verses.literalPt: mas, quando eu levantava a voz e gritava, deixou o seu vestido comigo e fugiu para fora.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אֲדֹנָ֜יו אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֣י אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבְּרָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כַּדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עָ֥שָׂהּ לִ֖י עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וַיִּ֖חַר אַפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵiš·mō·a‘ ’ă·ḏō·nāw ’eṯ- diḇ·rê ’iš·tōw ’ă·šer dib·bə·rāh ’ê·lāw lê·mōr kad·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ʿå̄·śå̄h lî ‘aḇ·de·ḵā way·yi·ḥar ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: When his master heard the story his wife told him saying This is what your slave did to me he burned with anger
verses.literalPt: Tendo o seu senhor ouvido as palavras de sua mulher, que lhe falava, dizendo: Desta maneira me fez teu servo, então, se acendeu a sua ira.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֲדֹנֵ֨י יוֹסֵ֜ף אֹת֗וֹ וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הַסֹּ֔הַר מְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ אֲסוּרֵי הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲסוּרִ֑ים וַֽיְהִי־ שָׁ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית הַסֹּֽהַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’ă·ḏō·nê yō·w·sêp̄ ’ō·ṯōw way·yit·tə·nê·hū ’el- bêṯ has·sō·har mə·qō·wm ’ă·šer- ʾă·sū·rē ham·me·leḵ ’ă·sū·rîm way·hî- šām bə·ḇêṯ has·sō·har
verses.literal: So Joseph’s master took him and had him thrown into the prison . . . where the king’s prisoners were confined While Joseph was there in the prison . . .
verses.literalPt: O senhor de José o tomou e o lançou no cárcere, no lugar em que os presos do rei estavam encarcerados; ali, esteve na prisão.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיֵּ֥ט אֵלָ֖יו חָ֑סֶד וַיִּתֵּ֣ן חִנּ֔וֹ בְּעֵינֵ֖י שַׂ֥ר בֵּית־ הַסֹּֽהַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî Yah·weh ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ way·yêṭ ’ê·lāw ḥā·seḏ way·yit·tên ḥin·nōw bə·‘ê·nê śar bêṯ- has·sō·har
verses.literal: the LORD was with him and extended kindness to him granting him favor in the eyes of the prison . . . warden
verses.literalPt: Jeová, porém, era com José, mostrou-lhe a sua benignidade e deu-lhe graça aos olhos do carcereiro.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֞ן שַׂ֤ר בֵּית־ הַסֹּ֙הַר֙ בְּיַד־ יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָ֣אֲסִירִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית הַסֹּ֑הַר וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ שָׁ֔ם ה֖וּא הָיָ֥ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên śar bêṯ- has·sō·har bə·yaḏ- yō·w·sêp̄ ’êṯ kāl- hā·’ă·sî·rim ’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ has·sō·har wə·’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ō·śîm šām hū hā·yāh ‘ō·śeh
verses.literal: And the warden . . . . . . put all the prisoners . . . under Joseph’s care so that he was responsible for all that was done in the prison
verses.literalPt: O carcereiro entregou às mãos de José todos os presos que estavam no cárcere; e ele fazia tudo o que se fazia ali.

verses.original: אֵ֣ין׀ שַׂ֣ר בֵּית־ הַסֹּ֗הַר רֹאֶ֤ה אֶֽת־ כָּל־ מְא֙וּמָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אִתּ֑וֹ וַֽאֲשֶׁר־ ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה מַצְלִֽיחַ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ên śar bêṯ- has·sō·har rō·’eh ’eṯ- kāl- mə·’ū·māh bə·yā·ḏōw ba·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’it·tōw wa·’ă·šer- hū ‘ō·śeh Yah·weh maṣ·lî·aḥ
verses.literal: The warden . . . . . . did not concern himself with anything . . . under Joseph’s care because the LORD was with Joseph and gave him success in whatever he did
verses.literalPt: O carcereiro não tinha cuidado de coisa alguma que estava na mão de José, porque Jeová era com ele, e tudo o que ele fazia Jeová tornava próspero.
